description: This file defines an abstract RecyclerView adapter with selection management, including state saving/restoring, item selection toggling, and interaction with Android lifecycle components.

classes.name: ExtendedListAdapter
classes.description: An abstract RecyclerView ListAdapter with selection capabilities, state persistence, and lifecycle awareness.

methods.name: enableSelection
methods.description: Enables item selection with state restoration and lifecycle management.

methods.name: setOnListChangedListener
methods.description: Sets a listener for list changes.

methods.name: getItemAtPosition
methods.description: Returns the item at a specified position.

methods.name: getSelectedItems
methods.description: Returns a list of currently selected items.

methods.name: toggleSelectionForItem
methods.description: Toggles selection state for a specific item by ID.

methods.name: getPositionById
methods.description: Finds the position of an item by its ID.

methods.name: onItemSelectedStatusChanged
methods.description: Updates the UI for item selection status.

methods.name: updateSelectedIds
methods.description: Updates the list of selected IDs based on current list.

methods.name: onCurrentListChanged
methods.description: Overrides to respond to list updates.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds view holder, updating selection UI if enabled.

methods.name: releaseReferences
methods.description: Releases references to prevent memory leaks.
